name: Control-Plane Source Package Build
purpose: Build and retain one exact content-addressed stegverse.control-plane source package from already-local canonical source so an existing governed transport can carry it without recreating source packaging per Goal Task.
trigger: canonical control-plane source is current and a consumer requires a portable exact source delta for an existing sovereign runtime
scope: one already-local canonical .github source root and one existing runtime outbox
reuse_instructions: Run only after or alongside the canonical reusable source-refresh lifecycle. The output is an exact content-addressed source package and does not authorize or execute transport. Consumers requiring movement must bind the package to existing RTC-INTERLOCK-INTR-TRANSPORT-008 / TVC relay authority rather than creating another sender, credential path, scheduler, or runtime.
